ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity dark field (estimated 85-90% coverage) with sparse, high-intensity white pixel clusters (estimated 10-15% coverage), creating localized high-contrast regions against a uniform dark background.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white geometric blobs include circular annuli (rosettes) scattered across the medial regions of both lobes, and elongated near-vertical linear strokes localized on the medial-lower quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression with a calculated vertex angle of approximately 45 degrees; vertex depth is approximately 25% of the total vertical height of the visible fluke lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Left lobe trailing edge shows frequent, low-amplitude serrations (approx. 5-10 pixel depth). Right lobe trailing edge is characterized by high-amplitude, irregular macro-notches (jagged indentations) with vertical drops exceeding 50 pixels in depth, isolated from the water line.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Both lobes exhibit a concave sweep trajectory originating from the distal tips and descending toward the median notch, with distal tips exhibiting a sharp upward-tapering curve.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and semi-circular white pixel rings (annuli) detected across the medial and distal surfaces of both lobes, ranging from approximately 15 to 40 pixels in diameter.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of at least four distinct, unaligned high-intensity linear tracks on the right lobe; three vertical streaks located medially and one diagonal streak located superior-distally.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Deep macro-level jagged tissue loss on the right lobe trailing edge; heavy clusters of high-intensity, textured pixel masses (barnacle colonies) are present on the extreme distal tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Low-density white pixel noise (mist/water spray) partially occludes the lower-medial region of the left lobe, resulting in a localized reduction of pigment contrast in that coordinate zone.
